user: And the FX spread if I pay in USD?
answer:
For a tier1 account, the tariff schedule sets the FX spread at **1.5%** over the mid-market rate. Each month you get a **EUR 500** free conversion allowance. If a conversion fits within your remaining allowance, no spread applies. Once the allowance is used up, the full 1.5% applies to the conversion.

I can't give you a full USD figure yet, for three reasons:

- I don't have a USD mid-market rate. The documentation doesn't include one, and I can get the live rate only through a quote.
- I don't know how much of your EUR 500 monthly allowance you've already used. My records show only your transfer limits, not your conversion usage.
- Card payments also carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. The documentation doesn't give that percentage, so I can't state it.

If you tell me an amount in EUR or USD, I can run a full quote showing the mid rate, spread, allowance applied, and final amount.

fragments.text:
Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Currency conversion operations
## When a conversion happens
A conversion happens when the payment currency differs from the currency of the
account being debited. The conversion is applied at settlement, not at
authorisation.

Verta tariff schedule
## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 1.5% | EUR 500 |
| Tier 2 | 0.9% | EUR 1,000 |
| Tier 3 | 0.5% | EUR 5,000 |
